title: CRMA® Certification (Certification in Risk Management Assurance)
body: The Institute of Internal Auditors (The IIA)
source: The IIA CRMA Exam Syllabus & Candidate Handbook
summary: The premier credential for internal audit risk leadership, evaluating enterprise risk management (ERM), risk culture, governance assurance, and strategic advisory across 3 core domains and 2 years risk assurance experience.

standard.name: Standard Risk Assurance Track
standard.blurb: Hold active CIA credential (or meet education/experience prerequisite), pass the 120-question exam (600/750 scaled score), and document 2 years of risk assurance experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Internal Audit & Governance Leadership
stages.subtitle: Domains 1 and 2: Roles and Responsibilities, and Risk Governance

nodes.name: Domain 1: Internal Audit Roles and Responsibilities
nodes.description: Internal audit roles in risk management: assurance vs consulting roles, maintaining objectivity, risk-based audit planning, and aligning internal audit strategy with enterprise ERM.
topics: Assurance and Consulting Mandates in Enterprise Risk Management
Safeguarding Internal Audit Independence and Objectivity in Risk Roles
Risk-Based Audit Planning & Audit Universe Alignment with Enterprise Risks

nodes.name: Domain 2: Risk Management Governance
nodes.description: Governance structures, board oversight, risk culture evaluation, Three Lines Model, risk appetite statements, and enterprise risk management framework integration (COSO ERM, ISO 31000).
topics: Board Risk Governance Structures & Risk Committee Charters
The IIA Three Lines Model: Operational Management, Risk/Compliance, and Internal Audit
Evaluating Enterprise Risk Culture, Ethics & Tone at the Top
Articulating Risk Appetite, Risk Capacity & Tolerance Thresholds

nodes.name: Domain 3: Risk Management Assurance
nodes.description: Evaluating risk identification, assessment, response, and monitoring processes; assessing emerging risks, cyber resilience, third-party risk, and reporting risk assurance to the board.
topics: Assessing Risk Identification, Measurement & Prioritization Methodologies
Evaluating Risk Mitigation Strategies & Key Control Effectiveness
Assuring Emerging Strategic Risks, Cybersecurity & Third-Party Vendor Risks
Formulating Comprehensive Risk Assurance Opinions for Executive Management & Board

nodes.name: CRMA Computer-Based Examination
nodes.format: 120 Multiple-Choice Questions and Advanced Case Scenarios
nodes.frequency: Continuous CBT testing globally via Pearson VUE
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing deep risk assurance, governance, and ERM evaluation. Scaled passing score: 600 out of 750.

stages.title: Stage 3: Experience & Credential Award
stages.subtitle: 2 Years Risk Management Assurance Experience + Annual CPE

nodes.name: 2 Years Risk Assurance / Internal Audit Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate at least 2 years of professional experience in risk management assurance, internal audit, ERM, or internal control assessment.
topics: Supervisory Verification in IIA CCMS Portal

nodes.name: CRMA Designation Conferred & Annual CPE
nodes.description: Official award of the Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA®). Requires 20 hours annual CPE (including 2 hours of ethics).
